en: Defensively, we just did it harder for longer stretches, and we were really in tune to what we were supposed to be doing.

en: We got away from what got us the 76 points in the first half, just in terms of putting pressure on the rim, rolling after screens, running, continuing to find the paint, whether it's for ourselves or for a teammate. We got on our heels and, you know, missed some shots, and then, you know, you don't get as many free throws and high, high-percentage looks when you play on your heels like that.
zh: 上半场拿76分靠的那套东西，我们丢了，就是冲击篮筐、挡拆后顺下，打快攻，一直往禁区里打，不管是自己打，还是给队友做机会。后来我们打得畏手畏脚，也丢了些球，这样一来，罚球就少了，好的出手机会也少了。打得这么被动，就会这样。

en: What's going through my mind right now? I think it's going to go one of two ways. One of two ways, and a bad one and a good one. And I know the bad one would be giving up, the good one would be getting stronger through this, getting more together. And I know this is what we're going to do.
zh: 我现在在想什么？我觉得接下来只有两条路。两条路，一条坏的，一条好的。坏的那条，是就此放弃；好的那条，是经历这一场，变得更强、更抱团。我知道，我们会走好的那条路。
